summary_plain: The objective of this investigation is to better understand the relationship between electric field voltage and chemi-ion current, analyze the dynamic response of flames to electric field changes, evaluate soot formation, and characterize stabilized near-limit lifted flames.
summary_expert: The objective of this investigation is to better understand the relationship between electric field voltage and chemi-ion current, analyze the dynamic response of flames to electric field changes, evaluate soot formation, and characterize stabilized near-limit lifted flames. The E-FIELD flames experiment investigates how electric fields influence the behavior of laminar diffusion flames in microgravity. This unique environment is ideal for isolating electric field effects from buoyancy forces.

key_findings.text: ACME/E-FIELD Flames Final Report (2019) 10 April 2021 40 Follow-On Experiments We hope to have a third round of testing so that we can concentrate on flames in the coflow burner configuration that we found to be the more useful and symmetric than those with the jet burner.
We did not get to limit flames except that we showed clearly how in microgravity a flame can be stabilized with a small field rather than simply expanding and extinguishing.
Early results have demonstrated that nitrogen applied to the flame can actually strengthen it because of this effect.

earth_applications: The use of electric fields to control flames can reduce the production of harmful pollutants in practical terrestrial combustion.
Combustion using electrical fields may also allow for more efficient combustion, reducing fuel consumption in addition to unwanted emissions.
